$schema: Visual style configuration for MBB-style decks. Used by scripts/build_deck.py.

profiles._note: Alternative typography profiles. The default values above are the 'presentation readability' standard. To use a profile, copy its values over typography.* (build_deck.py reads the top-level typography block); lint_deck.py accepts --profile to check a finished deck against a profile's size expectations.

dense._description: Consulting print density (Firm Learning standard): decks meant to be READ like documents, not projected. Title 18-22pt, body 8-11pt, footnotes 7-8pt.

sample_data_note: These values are tuned for a 16:9 widescreen layout (13.333 x 7.5 in). Adjust if your default slide size differs.
